steps.en: The officer adds a vehicle to the hitlist
steps.why_en: There is no hitlist and no add function.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada hitlist dan tidak ada fungsi tambah.

steps.en: The officer removes a vehicle from the hitlist
steps.why_en: There is no hitlist and no remove function.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada hitlist dan tidak ada fungsi hapus.

steps.en: A daily list is sent to the enforcement system
steps.id: Daftar harian dikirim ke sistem enforcement
steps.why_en: The list sent is not an officer-edited hitlist; it only follows suspension status.
steps.why_id: Daftar yang dikirim bukan hitlist hasil edit officer; hanya mengikuti status suspension.
